summary: Celesta and music-box bells: trap and lofi melodies, dreamy and dark
label: celesta
body: The short dark melody of trap (minor, sparse, high), or a lofi music-box line. Also: GeneralUser GS/Music Box, GeneralUser GS/Glockenspiel.

Register: MIDI 60-96 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Celeste, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Celeste") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
